text: I can name the three guarantees TLS provides and explain what each means.
I can describe the TLS 1.3 handshake and explain why it is faster than TLS 1.2.
I can explain the certificate chain (root → intermediate → leaf) and the role of certificate authorities.
I can explain TLS termination at a load balancer, its tradeoffs, and when to use mTLS for service-to-service auth.
I can explain Diffie–Hellman with the paint analogy and say what forward secrecy protects against.
